ordered_path.statement: POST /accounts/:accountId/entries is handled by postLedgerEntry from createLedgerRouter.
resolveRequestContext parses the bearer token and throws UnauthenticatedError when the token is missing or unknown.
assertAccountAccess rejects the request with ForbiddenError when the path accountId is not in principal.accountIds.
requireNumber and requireString validate amountMinor, currency, and idempotencyKey before the service is called.
LedgerService.postEntry first asks IdempotencyStore.find for a prior reservation and returns the stored entry when one exists.
LedgerStore.appendEntry appends a new immutable entry and allocates the entryId. Durable side effect.
IdempotencyStore.reserve records the key -> entryId mapping. This happens AFTER the append. Durable side effect.
OutboxPublisher.publish emits ledger.entry.posted synchronously to every subscribed handler. Durable side effect.
BalanceProjection.applyPosted is the downstream consumer of ledger.entry.posted and updates the derived account balance.
AuditLog.record writes the ledger.entry.posted audit row AFTER the outbox publish. Durable side effect.
The handler returns 201 with the created entry.

correct_uncertainty.requirement: No module in this workspace calls BalanceProjection.attach. The projection consumes ledger.entry.posted only if a composition root subscribes it, and no such composition root exists here. An answer that states the projection is definitely wired is over-claiming; an answer that omits the consumer entirely is incomplete.
The path is reconstructed from static call sites, not from an observed runtime trace.

unsupported_claim_traps.claim: Outbox events are persisted to a table or queue and delivered asynchronously by a worker.
unsupported_claim_traps.why_false: OutboxPublisher.publish invokes subscribed handlers inline; there is no store, no queue, and no worker.

unsupported_claim_traps.claim: The audit record is written before the outbox event is published.
unsupported_claim_traps.why_false: In LedgerService.postEntry the publish call precedes the auditLog.record call.

unsupported_claim_traps.claim: The idempotency key is reserved before the ledger entry is appended.
unsupported_claim_traps.why_false: reserve is called after appendEntry. This ordering is the seeded defect exercised by rootcause-ledger-duplicate-entries.

unsupported_claim_traps.claim: LedgerStore maintains or returns account balances.
unsupported_claim_traps.why_false: LedgerStore only appends and reads entries; balances exist only in BalanceProjection.

must_not_report_ready_when: any required_evidence_path is absent from the evidence set
the event edge from OutboxPublisher.publish to BalanceProjection is neither present nor declared as unresolved
